summary: Western Copper and Gold filed a 6-K attaching its October 26, 2026 news release disclosing that President and CEO Sandeep Singh will step down as CEO and director effective October 31, 2026. Chairman Mark E. Smith becomes Interim CEO and CFO Michael Psihogios adds the President title, both effective November 1, 2026, while the board launches an executive search for a permanent CEO. No terms, price, premium or advisor are stated; the release notes over C$120.6 million in cash and investments at September 30, 2026. Watch for search timing, continuity at the Casino YESAB Panel Review, and any strategic implications of new leadership.
